messages:
deploy-bot: Post-deploy checks for release v1.8.3 complete. Synthetic run: EU health probe flagged — failing 3/5 checks. See results: https://ci/reports/1934567890
synth-checker: EU region probe: 502 spike at 12:03 UTC, error rate 0.9% (baseline 0.02%). Pattern: short bursts for ~30s across multiple instances.
jamie: seeing the same in logs, pulling eu1 and eu2 logs now.
rohit: other regions healthy? :eyes:
deploy-bot: US/EAST and APAC show green. Only EU degraded. No retry budget exhausted.
sara: can we avoid full rollback? is region-pin feasible?
lin: yes — we can do per-region pin to previous version via the route API. Faster than rollback.
rohit: let's get stack traces before any change. jamie, paste the failing stack if you have it.
jamie: logs show a kvcache eviction oom then an HTTP handler panic. snippet:
```
2026-03-19T12:02:58Z ERROR kvcache: eviction loop failed: OOM while allocating 256MB
2026-03-19T12:03:01Z ERROR http: handler panic: nil pointer deref
2026-03-19T12:03:01Z WARN  router: instance eu2 restarted (exit code 137)
```
sara: looks like a memory regression after the runtime memory allocator tweak in this release.
lin: quick mitigation options: 1) pin EU to v1.8.2 (traffic split) 2) bump EU instance memory by 10% 3) scale up EU pool. Pin is fastest and reversible.
rohit: agree. pin EU to 1.8.2 for 30m, monitor metrics for 10m, then decide. jamie do the pin and notify oncall.
jamie: executing pin now:
```
POST /api/route-pin
{"region":"eu","service":"inference","version":"1.8.2","duration":"30m"}
```
jamie: done — route pin applied :white_check_mark: (eu -> v1.8.2, 30m).
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2145. Paging oncall (pager duty).
lin: any quick check to confirm user-facing improvement? run a single-threaded perf probe against eu endpoint.
rohit: running probe now...
deploy-bot: Probe results: EU latency/back to baseline within 90s after pin. Error rate dropped to 0.03%. Synthetic alert cleared pending 5m stable window.
sara: good. open a post-deploy issue to track the allocator regression and schedule a deeper infra debug.
jamie: created issue INF-778 with logs and minimal repro steps.
rohit: next steps: revert allocator tweak in a patch release, run longer soak in staging, then reintroduce with gradual canary.
lin: note for release notes: "patched memory allocator regression observed in EU; partial region pin applied". keep operations notes in the release ticket.
sara: thanks all. keep monitoring for the 30m pin window; if anything pops, we'll roll the EU traffic to standby region.
deploy-bot: Status: partial traffic pin active. EU synthetic checks passing. Will auto-unpin at 30m unless extended. :thumbsup:
